title: 先收敛后多样化：多目标贝叶斯优化中解耦收敛与多样性
summary: 本文提出"先收敛后多样化"(CTD)方法，将多目标贝叶斯优化中的收敛与多样性解耦为两个阶段：第一阶段快速收敛到帕累托前沿上的单点，第二阶段在前沿上扩展多样性。实验表明CTD在72.9%的对比中优于现有方法，尤其在预算紧张或高维问题中优势明显。
summary_en: This paper proposes a converge-then-diversify (CTD) approach that decouples convergence and diversity into two stages in multi-objective Bayesian optimisation: first quickly converging to a single point on the Pareto front, then spreading solutions across the front. Experiments show CTD statistically outperforms state-of-the-art methods in 72.9% of 446 pairwise comparisons, with advantages especially evident under tight budgets or high-dimensional problems.
